title: vibe coded and lacks polish
body: I really enjoy using this app because it unlocks a capability that was hard for me to use elsewhere. I also appreciate that it's open source. However, the app has a lot of trivial problems that would be readily solved by somebody who is versed cross-platform mobile development. I find that there frequent breaking changes to the app, such as navigation bugs, and the app is not optimized for long running chats or for lots of chats (for example, opening an old chat takes minutes to catch up).

title: Lies about data collection
body: Their website and privacy policy (updated January *2025*) say zero telemetry or usage statistics are collected. Yet there is literally a setting in the app to toggle usage statistics collection (which is on by default). Reporting this to Apple.

title: Really… fantastic!
body: I have been tempting in to my pc to use CLI when not at my desk. Being able to vibe code when not at my desk allows me to do other things while my RAG Agent works on my phased development tasks of the day. I usually check in periodically, but this app is a game changer. Real time chat. Hooks embedded to provide basic prompt responds to keep Claude running with simple task that are actually good. It’s like having ChatGPT for CLI. I also love being able to manage multiple CLIs and projects at the same time! And now I don’t stare at my screen watching it work. With iPhone notifications I get a quick reminder, can check what’s next and tell it what I the boss man wants and my little agent worker bees go back to work.

title: Stellar Work
body: So I was initially really "happy" with the app and its ability to let me code from the tub (I used to just have to do that in my head and then copy it out later at my desk) and that's still the most amazing experience. But while driving I tried out the voice interface and was blown away again. Finally and while you might have to be a dev to appreciate this, I've recently taken to very long winded intros to provide context and after ~15min of typing in details something went awry on my phone and the app blinked out.. terror.. but when I opened it back up every single character I'd typed was still there, nothing lost, a detail that tells you how good these devs are and what a work of passion this app and its infrastructure are. Love it to death.
